verdict.rationale: The California Secretary of State runs online portals with user accounts (bizfile, User Access), so asking about data retention and deletion is a fair question for this kind of service. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any user-facing retention settings, deletion requests, or data-lifecycle controls. User Access only controls who may submit filings, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
